standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the comparison of closed substacks to the invariance of a scheme theoretic image.

standard_prerequisites.name: The behaviour of the scheme theoretic image under flat base change in the case of schemes, and the invariance of the image under a further surjective smooth cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are used inside the counted proof (source lines 8947-8948 and 8954-8956, 8980-8983), the first with a pointer to the author lemma lemma-cover-upstairs counted separately in this lane
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the image to be computed after replacing the morphism by a surjective smooth covering morphism of schemes, and to be compared after flat base change.

core_obligations: Reduce to three statements about schemes: the proof chooses flat smooth presentations adapted to the base change, names the four scheme theoretic images involved, and observes that it suffices to prove the three displayed equalities (proof lines 8892-8918)

First equality: using the correspondence between closed substacks of the target and invariant closed subspaces of the presentation, the proof shows that the scheme theoretic image of the base changed morphism is invariant, by computing its preimages under the two projections as scheme theoretic images of the same morphism and invoking the flat base change statement for schemes and the covering lemma (proof lines 8920-8965)
Second equality: the same argument as for the first (proof lines 8967-8968)
Third equality: restricting to a component of the presentation and using the flatness of the map between the two components, the proof reduces to the scheme case (proof lines 8970-8983)
proof_roadmap: 取适合的满光滑展示 V = ⊔V_i、V' = ⊔V_{i,j}（后者映入前者），记 Z、Z'、Z、Z' 四个 scheme theoretic image；只要证 (a) Z = V ×_Y Z、(b) Z' = V' ×_{Y'} Z'、(c) Z' = V' ×_V Z 即可（因 Z' → Z ×_Y Y' 在满光滑 V' → Y' 的基变换下是同构，由 lemma-factor-factor 得它本身是同构）。

(a)：由「闭子叠 ↔ 展示的 R-不变闭子空间」的对应用 R = V ×_Y V 的不变性；把 pr_0^{-1}(Z) 与 pr_1^{-1}(Z) 都算成 X ×_Y R → R 的 scheme theoretic image（用概型层面的平坦基变换 + lemma-cover-upstairs）。(b) 同法。(c)：约化到每个 V_i 与 V_{i,j}，用概型情形与 V_{i,j} → V_i 平坦。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic stacks the formation of the scheme theoretic image commutes with flat base change (author lemma at source lines 8884-8889, label lemma-existence-plus-flat-base-change). The proof (source lines 8891-8984) chooses flat smooth presentations adapted to the base change and reduces the assertion to three equalities of scheme theoretic images; the first and second are proved by the correspondence between closed substacks and invariant closed subspaces, computing two preimages as the scheme theoretic image of one morphism and using the flat base change statement for schemes together with the invariance of the image under a further smooth cover; the third is reduced componentwise to the scheme case (proof lines 8920-8983). The invariance argument through the presentation is the content. H3.
